outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section)
cohort: The study included all eligible pregnant women who presented for antenatal care and delivered at General Hospital Bonny, Nigeria, between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2020.
finding: The study revealed a statistically significant association between maternal mean arterial blood pressure, age, marital status, and employment status with caesarean section as the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Maternal age, mean arterial blood pressure, marital status, and employment status were identified as predictors of the mode of delivery, specifically caesarean section.
